title: Door Gates
description: Ever wanted more retro feeling gates? Well cut those doors in half and down the middle and use it as a gate with Door Gates!
body:
I was creating a retro modpack for myself and thought to customize the fence gates! I came up with a simple design of just bottom door blocks (they split down the middle like normal gates) to fit the vibe. 

Door gates is only a model change and uses any textures from your texture packs! I recommend Order of the Stone which I use or Golden Days. Please report issues to me at buggybuggy._. on discord.

Enjoy!
